scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p spike-kernel-wasm && mkdir -p dist-wasm && wasm-opt -Oz --strip-debug --strip-producers --enable-bulk-memory --enable-bulk-memory-opt --enable-sign-ext --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --enable-mutable-globals --enable-multivalue --enable-reference-types target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/spike_kernel_wasm.wasm -o dist-wasm/kernel.wasm
scripts.build:ts: bun build worker/entry-ts.ts --outfile dist-ts/index.js --target browser --format esm --minify --external 'cloudflare:*'
scripts.build:rust: bun build worker/entry-rust.ts --outfile dist-rust/index.js --target browser --format esm --minify --external 'cloudflare:*' --external '*.wasm' && cp dist-wasm/kernel.wasm dist-rust/
scripts.build:rust-instance: bun build worker/entry-rust-instance.ts --outfile dist-rust-instance/index.js --target browser --format esm --minify --external 'cloudflare:*' --external '*.wasm' && cp dist-wasm/kernel.wasm dist-rust-instance/
scripts.build:ts-coalesce: bun build worker/entry-ts-coalesce.ts --outfile dist-ts-coalesce/index.js --target browser --format esm --minify --external 'cloudflare:*'
scripts.build:rust-coalesce: bun build worker/entry-rust-coalesce.ts --outfile dist-rust-coalesce/index.js --target browser --format esm --minify --external 'cloudflare:*' --external '*.wasm' && cp dist-wasm/kernel.wasm dist-rust-coalesce/
scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:ts && bun run build:rust && bun run build:rust-instance && bun run build:ts-coalesce && bun run build:rust-coalesce
